DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: waystation
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A roadside facility that provides lodging, supplies and fresh transport for travellers and caravans. It encourages trade and settlement while greatly reducing the time caravans need to enter this tile.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: adventurer camp
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A lively camp where travellers and aspiring adventurers gather. Every two days it introduces a new recruit; a stronger population tendency improves the odds of finding exceptional people. The management window must be reopened after it is built for its new page to appear.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: inn
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A comfortable roadside inn that draws travellers and prospective settlers to the outpost.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: luxury hotel
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: An opulent hotel and restaurant whose lavish hospitality attracts celebrated visitors from far away.
